name: Sealed
meaning: An asterisk hidden in negative space.

name: keysy*
meaning: An asterisk integrated into the name.

name: Keyhole
meaning: The original keyhole icon forms the upright of a K, completed by two plain diagonal strokes.

name: Gate
meaning: Enclose a private value, leaving only a controlled entrance. Strong standalone silhouette; more abstract meaning.
